svg.title: Conceptual protocol separating training, calibration, threshold selection and testing
svg.desc: Independent scene groups feed separate source training, development, calibration, threshold selection and held-out tests. A frozen detector and candidate policy are evaluated on clear and shifted test groups. Group bootstrap refits calibration and threshold selection. The figure contains no empirical results.
svg.metadata: GPT original proposed protocol, 2026-11-03. Conceptual foundations: https://arxiv.org/html/2412.01782v4 Figures 6–7 and Section V; https://arxiv.org/html/2405.20459v1 Section 4. No source figure copied. Detailed provenance in ../research_summary.md.
svg.text: Separate the information used to fit, choose and evaluate
CONCEPTUAL · GPT protocol proposal · G0 pending actual data counts and GPU tests
Freeze ontology, annotation extent and independent scene / recording groups
Strict clear-day source · Joint weather × time slices · Keep related views in one partition
Frozen weights + preprocessing + candidate policy + score map + t*
Cache stable IDs · NMS / top-k · caps · class filtering order · deterministic ties
Report transferred recall, FPPI, held-out transfer loss, shortfall and candidate ceiling
Paired group uncertainty · Refit calibration and reselect thresholds in procedure-level replicates
Strict global monotone map + equivariant recall reselection → identical selected boxes
A probability-calibration gain can coexist with unchanged recall. New target labels define an adaptation arm.
Foundations: Park et al., Figs. 6–7 / §V; Kuzucu et al., §4. Original layout and proposed splits; no source figure copied.
